status: post hoc extension analysis; run list fixed before execution
lower_bounds: Re-evaluate the stored supporting-plane witness exactly for every reached budget. Preserve the original rigorous lower bound only after equality is checked.
upper_bounds: Use the saved incumbent registry snapshot. Check integer allocations, budget and box; evaluate exact variance. Include each PSO allocation when checking whether the incumbent is best.
uncertainty: Separate exact optimization brackets from seed-sampling uncertainty. For each fixed field and iteration count, a marginal distribution-free median confidence interval uses lower-end order statistic 8 and upper-end order statistic 18 of n=25. Coverage >=1-2*sum(comb(25,j),j=0..7)/2**25 under independent-run sampling; no simultaneous coverage claim.
quantiles: Descriptive sample median and IQR use exact linear interpolation, with interval endpoints rounded outward.
